@onready var ui_label: Label = %Label
@onready var shadow: Sprite2D = $Shadow
@onready var indicator: Sprite2D = %Indicator
@onready var restart_button: Button = $RestartButton
@onready var spawn_timer_node: Timer = $SpawnTimer
@onready var wave_timer: Timer = $WaveTimer

const FALLING_ITEM_SCENE: PackedScene = preload("res://falling_item.tscn")
const ROCK_SCENE: PackedScene = preload("res://rock.tscn")
const RUBY_SCENE: PackedScene = preload("res://ruby.tscn")

const START_POSITION: Vector2 = Vector2(576, 600)
const MIN_X: float = 64.0
const MAX_X: float = 1088.0
const START_Y: float = 80.0
const SPAWN_MIN_X: float = 64.0
const SPAWN_MAX_X: float = 1088.0
const INITIAL_LIVES: int = 3
const INITIAL_STARS_COUNT: int = 5
const DIFFICULTY_RAMP_SECONDS: float = 60.0
const SPAWN_INTERVAL_MAX: float = 2.0
const SPAWN_INTERVAL_MIN: float = 0.5
const MAX_SPEED_BOOST: float = 150.0
const SCORE_SPEED_BOOST: float = 10.0
const WIN_SCORE: int = 100
const ROCK_START_X: float = 160.0
const ROCK_END_X: float = 960.0
const ROCK_ROW_Y: float = 200.0
const ROCK_SPACING: float = 200.0

enum GameState { PLAYING, GAME_OVER, PAUSED, WIN }

var current_state: GameState = GameState.PLAYING
var player_name: String = "Cesto"
var speed: float = 350.0
var lives: int = INITIAL_LIVES
var score: int = 0
var is_active: bool = true
var current_wave: int = 1

var game_time: float = 0.0

var stars: Array[FallingItem] = []
var rubies: Array[Sprite2D] = []

var collected_counts: Dictionary = {
	"star": 0,
	"gold_star": 0,
	"rock": 0,
	"diamond": 0,
}


func _ready() -> void:
	position = START_POSITION
	modulate = Color.GREEN
	update_ui()
	spawn_initial_stars(INITIAL_STARS_COUNT)
	spawn_rock_row()
	spawn_ruby(Vector2(500.0, 100.0))
	spawn_timer_node.timeout.connect(_on_spawn_timer_timeout)
	wave_timer.timeout.connect(_on_wave_timer_timeout)
	print("Cesto pronto: ", player_name, " in ", position)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match current_state:
		GameState.PLAYING:
			if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_cancel"):
				current_state = GameState.PAUSED
				ui_label.text = "Gioco in pausa. Premi Esc per riprendere"
			else:
				process_playing(delta)
		GameState.GAME_OVER:
			check_restart()
		GameState.PAUSED:
			if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_cancel"):
				current_state = GameState.PLAYING
				update_ui()
		GameState.WIN:
			if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept"):
				reset_game()


func process_playing(delta: float) -> void:
	game_time += delta
	move_basket(delta)
	check_stars()
	check_rubies()
	check_win()
	check_game_over()


func _on_spawn_timer_timeout() -> void:
	if current_state == GameState.PLAYING:
		spawn_star()
		spawn_timer_node.wait_time = get_spawn_interval()


func _on_wave_timer_timeout() -> void:
	if current_state != GameState.PLAYING:
		return
	
	spawn_timer_node.stop()
	current_wave += 1
	ui_label.text = "Pausa! In arrivo ondata " + str(current_wave)
	
	await get_tree().create_timer(3.0).timeout
	
	if current_state == GameState.PLAYING:
		if spawn_timer_node.wait_time > 0.4:
			spawn_timer_node.wait_time -= 0.2
		spawn_timer_node.start()
		wave_timer.start(10.0)
		update_ui()


func move_basket(delta: float) -> void:
	var direction: float = 0.0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
		direction -= 1.0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
		direction += 1.0
	
	position.x += direction * speed * delta
	position.x = clamp(position.x, MIN_X, MAX_X)


func get_difficulty_factor() -> float:
	return min(game_time / DIFFICULTY_RAMP_SECONDS, 1.0)


func get_spawn_interval() -> float:
	var interval: float = lerpf(SPAWN_INTERVAL_MAX, SPAWN_INTERVAL_MIN, get_difficulty_factor())
	return max(interval, SPAWN_INTERVAL_MIN)


func spawn_item_at(spawn_pos: Vector2, item_type: String) -> FallingItem:
	var new_item: FallingItem = FALLING_ITEM_SCENE.instantiate() as FallingItem
	new_item.apply_item_type(item_type)
	new_item.position = spawn_pos
	add_child(new_item)
	stars.append(new_item)
	return new_item


func spawn_ruby(spawn_pos: Vector2) -> Sprite2D:
	var ruby: Sprite2D = RUBY_SCENE.instantiate() as Sprite2D
	ruby.position = spawn_pos
	add_child(ruby)
	rubies.append(ruby)
	return ruby


func spawn_star() -> void:
	var random_x: float = randf_range(SPAWN_MIN_X, SPAWN_MAX_X)
	var types: Array[String] = ["star", "gold_star", "rock", "diamond"]
	var chosen_type: String = types[randi_range(0, types.size() - 1)]
	
	var new_star: FallingItem = spawn_item_at(Vector2(random_x, START_Y), chosen_type)
	var speed_boost: float = lerpf(0.0, MAX_SPEED_BOOST, get_difficulty_factor())
	new_star.accelerate(speed_boost)


func spawn_initial_stars(count: int) -> void:
	for i in range(count):
		spawn_star()


func check_stars() -> void:
	for i in range(stars.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var current_star: FallingItem = stars[i]
		if not is_instance_valid(current_star):
			stars.remove_at(i)
			continue
		
	if current_star.is_caught(global_position):
			if current_star.is_penalty():
				take_damage(1)
			else:
				add_score(current_star.points)
			if current_star.item_name in collected_counts:
				collected_counts[current_star.item_name] += 1
			stars.remove_at(i)
			current_star.queue_free()
		elif current_star.is_out_of_bounds():
			stars.remove_at(i)
			current_star.queue_free()


func check_rubies() -> void:
	for i in range(rubies.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var ruby: Sprite2D = rubies[i]
		if not is_instance_valid(ruby):
			rubies.remove_at(i)
			continue
		
	if ruby.hits_basket(global_position):
			add_score(ruby.points)
			rubies.remove_at(i)
			ruby.queue_free()
		elif ruby.position.y > 680.0:
			rubies.remove_at(i)
			ruby.queue_free()


func get_collected_count(type_name: String) -> int:
	return collected_counts.get(type_name, 0)


func boost_all_stars(extra_speed: float) -> void:
	for star in stars:
		star.accelerate(extra_speed)


func spawn_rock_row() -> void:
	var current_x: float = ROCK_START_X
	while current_x <= ROCK_END_X:
		var rock: Sprite2D = ROCK_SCENE.instantiate() as Sprite2D
		rock.position = Vector2(current_x, ROCK_ROW_Y)
		add_child(rock)
		current_x += ROCK_SPACING


func update_ui() -> void:
	ui_label.text = "Punti: %04d | Vite: %d" % [score, lives]
	if lives >= 3:
		indicator.modulate = Color.GREEN
	elif lives == 2:
		indicator.modulate = Color.YELLOW
	else:
		indicator.modulate = Color.RED


func set_speed(new_speed: float) -> void:
	speed = new_speed


func add_score(amount: int) -> void:
	score += amount
	boost_all_stars(SCORE_SPEED_BOOST)
	update_ui()
	check_win()


func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
	lives -= amount
	if lives <= 0:
		lives = 0
		is_active = false
	update_ui()
	check_game_over()


func check_win() -> void:
	if score >= WIN_SCORE:
		current_state = GameState.WIN
		ui_label.text = "Vittoria! Punti: %d | Premi Invio per giocare ancora" % score


func check_game_over() -> void:
	if lives <= 0:
		current_state = GameState.GAME_OVER
		indicator.modulate = Color.DARK_RED
		ui_label.text = "Partita finita! Clicca Ricomincia per riprovare"
		restart_button.visible = true
		spawn_timer_node.stop()
		wave_timer.stop()


func check_restart() -> void:
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept"):
		reset_game()


func reset_game() -> void:
	for star in stars:
		if is_instance_valid(star):
			star.queue_free()
	stars.clear()
	
	for ruby in rubies:
		if is_instance_valid(ruby):
			ruby.queue_free()
	rubies.clear()
	
	lives = INITIAL_LIVES
	score = 0
	current_wave = 1
	game_time = 0.0
	position = START_POSITION
	current_state = GameState.PLAYING
	is_active = true
	restart_button.visible = false
	spawn_timer_node.wait_time = SPAWN_INTERVAL_MAX
	spawn_timer_node.start()
	wave_timer.start(10.0)
	update_ui()


func get_catch_point() -> Vector2:
	return global_position


func _on_restart_button_pressed() -> void:
	restart_button.visible = false
	reset_game()
